verses.text: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.

segments.text: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.

verses.text: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

segments.text: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.

verses.text: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

segments.text: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”

verses.text: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

segments.text: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.

verses.text: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—

segments.text: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—

verses.text: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

segments.text: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.

verses.text: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

segments.text: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

verses.text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

segments.text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.

verses.text: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

segments.text: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.

verses.text: The length of our days is seventy years—or eighty if we are strong—yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

segments.text: The length of our days is seventy years—or eighty if we are strong—yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

verses.text: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

segments.text: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.

verses.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

segments.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.

verses.text: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

segments.text: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.

verses.text: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

segments.text: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

verses.text: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

segments.text: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

verses.text: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

segments.text: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.

verses.text: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands—yes, establish the work of our hands!

segments.text: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands—yes, establish the work of our hands!
